tasks.prTitle: docs(eng-harness): edit-cycle plan T3 lists the kind module so that the effects record can be stored (B-513)
tasks.notes: AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; a chat line of the owner is not your task; NEEDS_OWNER only for a decision the documents do not contain. Documents-only plan amendment, the smallest edit (lead decisions D-12 and D-28), first-live-run path. Work item B-197 (edit-cycle plan 0007 T3, calc harness.expected_effects) is written and committed in the worktree <worktrees>/b197 (branch feat/b197-harness-wt3-calc-harness-expected-effects, commits 22d4321 test and bda000f feat, 294 counted lines of 340; READ-ONLY for you; handoff note <lead>/reports/b197-writer.md, lead material never cited by path in the repository). The calc works and the gate without mutation passes, but its record cannot be stored: the kind harness.expected_effects/1 is registered in packages/eng-harness/src/eng_harness/kinds/calcs.py as a plain model with extra=forbid and without the three wrapper members (calc, draft, trace) that the calc port adds to every calc body before the store validates it; that file is not in T3's files. The writer's trial patch is <lead>/reports/b197-trial-kind-payload.patch (three optional members on ExpectedEffects; with it the gate passes; it also moves the content hashes of six other draft calcs because kinds/calcs.py is in every calc's hash closure, and the footing verification record docs/verification/calcs/harness.footing_subjects.md pins its hash literal and must follow). Before editing the plan, decide the FORM from the documents and the merged code, not from the patch alone: read calcs spec 0003 on what a calc result kind carries (the payload wrapper: how harness.model_diff, harness.readback_check and harness.change_set_check kinds are declared in kinds/calcs.py and kinds/edit_cycle.py, whether through a common base such as CalcPayload with required members or otherwise) and spec 0007 where harness.expected_effects/1 is defined, and note that the merged read-back calc takes this kind as its `effects` input and that golden files and a kind fixture already hold bodies of it without the wrapper. State in T3's prose which form applies (the same base as the other calc kinds if the merged goldens and fixtures of other tasks can stay valid, otherwise the optional members, with the reason), and add one sentence to spec 0007 or 0003 only if the kind's definition there contradicts it. Then edit packages/eng-harness/docs/plans/0007-model-edit-cycle.md: T3 `files` gains src/eng_harness/kinds/calcs.py and docs/verification/calcs/harness.footing_subjects.md (and any other file the chosen form needs: verify by a trial in a scratch worktree made from the B-197 head, for example <worktrees>/b513-trial: apply the edit, regenerate the lock with `uv run python -m eng_harness._calc._hash --write-lock`, run `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation` to `check: pass`, list every file touched, remove the scratch worktree; never commit in <worktrees>/b197), with YAML amendment comments (B-513); max_changed_lines stays 340 unless your count says otherwise (311 measured with the trial); add the tests_first or implementation-commit test the writer names (a test that validates each golden body with the wrapper through the kind) where the gate's test-first rule allows it (TF004: it must be red at the base if it is in the first test commit). Also give a home, without designing behaviour, to two defects of the merged calc harness.change_set_check that the T3 writer found: it does not raise INVALID_ITEM_ID for an item id containing '/' although spec 0007 section 4.4.1 K3 requires it, and two terms of one combination item with the same key are not refused: verify both against the merged code and the spec; if the spec requires the refusal, add the calc's file and a named test to the smallest not-yet-written task that can carry them (or one small new task after T3, which will get a work item from the lead), otherwise record an open question. Another amendment (B-511, pre-flight audit fixes for T4 and T6 to T12 of this plan) is queued in another lane and does not touch T3: keep your edit inside T3 and the one home above, and merge origin/build/v1 before you finish. The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.
